notes: Fixes two real bugs found from a user-captured device log: quality1 always showing 0 in the app (was reading the wrong field - no firmware change needed for this part, requires the matching v3.10.2 app update) and reps being silently dropped during continuous/fast sets where the sensor never fully settles between reps (a segment could contain several reps but only the highest peak was reported - now every rep in a segment is detected and reported). Update both firmware and app together.
